_comment: Seed for tools/learn-routes.js until Highams Park has a definition. Not loaded by the backend (a dotted file name is not a definition). Highams Park (Larkshall Road, NR 2629, CCTV) has NO barrier bits in the signalling feed (Q4 scan 2026-11-21), so its clear steps come from the berth map data (SMART) and the map, not from the barrier; the timings around them need field taps. Direction slots: up = towards Liverpool Street, down = towards Chingford.

clear._provenance: From SMART (19 Nov) + OpenStreetMap, not barrier data: 1432 is the up platform berth (SMART: 1434>1432 arrive Highams Park plat 1 +43 s, 1432>1430 depart -12 s); the crossing (51.607888,-0.000393) is ~55 m south of the station's south entrance (51.60840), i.e. at the London end, so an up train crosses the road just after leaving 1432. The barrier-up lag after this step is unmeasured (no barrier bits): field taps needed.

From SMART (19 Nov) + OpenStreetMap, not barrier data: 1429 is the down platform berth (SMART: 1427>1429 arrive Highams Park plat 2 +40 s, 1429>1431 depart -34 s); with the crossing at the London end, a down train crosses the road between stepping into 1429 and stopping. The barrier-up lag after this step is unmeasured: field taps needed.
